result.summary: This agreement sets out the terms for Alex Morgan to provide design and build services for Northwind Digital Ltd's customer website. It lasts for twelve months and renews automatically unless notice is given. The agreement heavily favors the client by allowing unpaid scope changes, withholding of payment, global non-compete restrictions, and unlimited liability for the contractor.

quote.text: This Agreement is made on 1 October 2026 between Northwind Digital Ltd ("the Client") and Alex Morgan ("the Contractor
This Agreement lasts for twelve (12) months and renews automatically for further twelve-month periods unless either party gives notice
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales

obligations.description: Design and build the client's customer website as described in the project brief.

quote.text: The Contractor will design and build the Client's customer website as described in the project brief

obligations.description: Submit invoices within 14 days of completing a milestone, otherwise they will not be paid.
obligations.when: Within 14 days of completing a milestone

quote.text: Invoices must be submitted within 14 days of completing a milestone; late invoices will not be paid

obligations.description: Keep the client's information confidential during the agreement and for an unlimited period afterward.
obligations.when: During this Agreement and for an unlimited period afterwards

quote.text: The Contractor must keep the Client's information confidential during this Agreement and for an unlimited period afterwards

obligations.description: Pay the fees within 90 days of receiving a valid invoice, unless payment is withheld due to dissatisfaction.
obligations.when: Within 90 days of receiving a valid invoice

quote.text: The Client will pay the Fees within ninety (90) days of receiving a valid invoice

risks.title: Unpaid Scope Changes
risks.plain_language: The client can change the scope of services at any time in writing, but the fees will not change unless the client agrees in writing.
risks.why_it_matters: You could be forced to do extra work without any additional compensation if the client refuses to agree to a fee increase.

quotes.text: The Client may change the scope of the Services at any time by written notice. The Fees will not change unless the Client agrees otherwise in writing

risks.title: Payment Withholding
risks.plain_language: The client may withhold any payment if it is not satisfied with the deliverables.
risks.why_it_matters: The client has sole discretion over whether to pay you based on their satisfaction, which creates a high risk of delayed or missed income.

quotes.text: The Client may withhold any payment if it is not satisfied with the Deliverables

risks.title: Assignment of Pre-existing Intellectual Property
risks.plain_language: All rights in the deliverables, including any pre-existing materials of yours used in them, are assigned to the client upon creation.
risks.why_it_matters: You permanently lose ownership of your pre-existing tools, templates, or draft materials used to create the work.

quotes.text: All rights in the Deliverables, including any pre-existing materials of the Contractor used in them, are assigned to the Client on creation

risks.title: Global Non-Competition
risks.plain_language: For twenty-four months after the agreement ends, you cannot provide services to any business that competes with the client anywhere in the world.
risks.why_it_matters: This severely restricts your ability to earn a living in your field after the contract ends, and worldwide geographic scope is extremely difficult to comply with.

quotes.text: For twenty-four (24) months after this Agreement ends, the Contractor will not provide services to any business that competes with the Client anywhere in the world

risks.title: Unlimited Liability and Indemnity
risks.plain_language: You are liable for all losses suffered by the client without limit, and you must indemnify the client against any third-party claims relating to the deliverables.
risks.why_it_matters: A single mistake or third-party claim could result in financial damages that far exceed the total fees you earn under the contract.

quotes.text: The Contractor is liable for all losses suffered by the Client arising from the Services, without limit
The Contractor will indemnify the Client against any claim by a third party relating to the Deliverables

risks.title: Asymmetric Termination Rights
risks.plain_language: The client can terminate the agreement at any time with immediate effect, while you must give ninety days' written notice. Upon termination, the client only pays for accepted deliverables.
risks.why_it_matters: You are locked into a long notice period if you want to leave, while the client can walk away instantly and refuse to pay for unaccepted work.

quotes.text: The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time with immediate effect. The Contractor may terminate on ninety (90) days' written notice
On termination the Client will pay only for Deliverables it has accepted

risks.title: Unilateral Changes to Terms
risks.plain_language: The client may update the terms by posting a new version on its portal, and your continued work constitutes acceptance.
risks.why_it_matters: The client can alter your contract terms secretly or disadvantageously without your direct signature or active agreement.

quotes.text: The Client may update these terms by posting a new version on its supplier portal. Continued work by the Contractor means acceptance

risks.title: Portfolio Restriction
risks.plain_language: You may not show the deliverables in a portfolio without the client's prior written consent.
risks.why_it_matters: You cannot use the work to market your freelance business or showcase your portfolio publicly without explicit permission.

quotes.text: The Contractor may not show the Deliverables in a portfolio without the Client's prior written consent

risks.title: Binding Arbitration and Class-Action Waiver
risks.plain_language: Any dispute must be resolved by binding arbitration in London, and you waive any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
risks.why_it_matters: You give up your right to a court trial and cannot pool resources with other contractors in a class action if a systemic dispute arises.

quotes.text: Any dispute will be resolved by binding arbitration in London. The Contractor waives any right to bring or join a class or collective action
